mechanism: Propylthiouracil may increase rosuvastatin levels through potential inhibition of hepatic metabolism and transporter systems, while both drugs can rarely cause myopathy; concurrent use requires monitoring for statin-related muscle toxicity.
action: Monitor for signs of myopathy (muscle pain, weakness) and consider liver function monitoring; dose adjustment of rosuvastatin may be necessary if used concurrently with propylthiouracil.
